name: How does AKN Design Group approach scheduling for a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group approach scheduling for a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a whole-home remodel, AKN Design Group implements a meticulously planned schedule that coordinates all phases, from initial demolition and structural changes to final finish work. Our integrated design-build process ensures a cohesive timeline, managing kitchen and bathroom renovations, flooring, lighting, and carpentry as one unified project. We establish a master project timeline with clear milestones, providing homeowners with transparency and a single point of coordination. This approach helps to prevent delays often associated with juggling multiple vendors, ensuring a smoother, more predictable progression towards your home's complete transformation.
acceptedAnswer.description: We develop a master project timeline for whole-home remodels, coordinating all phases from demolition to finish work within our integrated design-build process for a seamless experience.
